summary: The diff implements most of the required changes: backend comment pool refactoring with status-based records, migration module, generateSingle/generateBulk rewrites, getPoolStats update, and frontend modal error handling in both SingleGeneratorView.tsx and BulkGeneratorView.tsx. However, several specific acceptance criteria have concerns based on the available evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: The modal displays the exact error message string from the backend. When generateSingle returns 'Pool is empty', the modal should show 'Pool is empty' exactly.
missing_requirements.reason: SingleGeneratorView.tsx maps the backend error 'Pool is empty' to the user-facing string 'No comments left. Please try later.' instead of displaying the exact backend error message string as required by the AC.

missing_requirements.requirement: After a successful generation, immediately refetch pool stats so the displayed 'Comments left: X' count is accurate.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff for SingleGeneratorView.tsx shows no explicit call to invalidate or refetch the poolStats query after a successful generateSingle. The useGenerateSingle mutation in useQueries.ts would need an onSuccess invalidation for the poolStats query key, but the truncated diff does not confirm this is present.

missing_requirements.requirement: The modal shows the backend error message text exactly (e.g., 'Only X comments left. Reduce quantity.').
missing_requirements.reason: BulkGeneratorView.tsx conditionally maps the error to 'No comments left. Please try later.' when available === 0, rather than always showing the exact backend error string. This may cause mismatch when the backend returns the specific 'Only X comments left. Reduce quantity.' message.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each comment record must use the field name 'commentId' (Nat) as specified.
missing_requirements.reason: Both backend/main.mo and backend/migration.mo define the Comment record with field 'id' instead of 'commentId' as specified in the requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: A separate migration.mo module file was created as a standalone file.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request constraint states all Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture). Creating a separate backend/migration.mo module may violate this constraint, even if imported into main.mo.

hallucinated_features.description: BulkGeneratorView maps 'Not authorized' error to a custom message and checks available === 0 to override backend error messages with custom strings.
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec only requires showing the backend error message in the modal. Custom error message mapping and special-casing for 'Not authorized' or available count were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: SingleGeneratorView maps 'Pool is empty' and 'Not authorized' to custom user-friendly strings instead of passing the backend message through directly.
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec requires the modal to display the exact error message string from the backend. Custom mapping logic was not requested.
